title: VDS enforcement lock entry
description: One pinned proof script and the wiring that makes it enforcement. Governed by VDS S-8. The lock is held OUTSIDE the scripts it witnesses, so a weakening edit bumps a digest and trips a blocking finding rather than passing under its own possibly weakened logic. An entry cannot be written without naming the test that proves the script's FAILING direction, which is how VDS S-7(2)(2) is made structural rather than aspirational.

path.description: Repository-relative path, no leading slash. This is the file whose bytes are witnessed.

digest.description: sha256 of the file at pin time. Any difference is a fatal drift finding (VDS S-8(4)).

invoked_by.description: What runs this script that is not the author choosing to run it (VDS S-7(2)(3)). An empty array is not representable, because an uninvoked gate is not enforcement.

ref.description: The exact invocation site, for example ".githooks/pre-push:106" or ".github/workflows/ci.yml#design-gates".

blocking.description: False records honestly that this surface reports without blocking. A non-blocking surface alone does not satisfy VDS S-7(2)(3).

proves.description: The proof kinds this script produces. A script that produces no kind in the closed registry may not be pinned (VDS S-7(5)).

failing_direction_test.description: The test that seeds a violation against a fixture and asserts the non-zero exit. Without it the script has proven only its happy path (VDS S-7(2)(2)).

seeds.description: What violation the test seeds, in one line, so a reviewer can tell whether the seeded violation is the one that matters.

relock_rationale.description: Required when re-pinning after a deliberate gate change. Re-locking without recording why, and without self-filing under VDS S-12(3), is itself the breach the lock exists to make visible.

supersedes_digest.description: The digest this entry replaced, so a weakening re-lock is readable as a diff rather than as a fresh fact.
